name: Advanced Ascetic Path [Psionic]
body:
You are an expert of unarmed combat.

Prerequisites: Dodge, Psionic Dodge, Ascetic path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: The competence bonus of your Ascetic trance now applies to both AC and saves. In addition, when using the Ascetic maneuver, you can deflect one attack as if using the Deflect Arrows feat, although you may alternatively deflect a melee attack.
